items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1960
items.q: I played in the Blue Room, Roosevelt Hotel with A.J. Piron.

ctx.x: Mr. Dewey, we'd like to know how many of the men in these, uh, groups that you played with

red music. They're all red except my, except I. I, the only one didn't read, but I played so good that the violin player Pierron, Mr. Pierron, offered to teach me for nothing. Good. Mr. Dewey, would you
tell us about the various jobs that you played, how you got them, and how you made arrangements for them?
